preheader: Anthropic reports massive revenue ahead of its IPO, and Alexander Zverev takes the tennis No. 1 spot.

lead.headline: Anthropic Reports Surge in Revenue and Huge Losses Ahead of Wall Street Debut
lead.body: Ahead of its public listing later this month, AI developer Anthropic reported a staggering 1,200% increase in quarterly revenue to $33.24 billion. At the same time, its filings reveal a $104 billion net loss and nearly $900 billion in future infrastructure commitments as it races to build out its AI computing capacity.
lead.why: This is a prime case study for your corporate finance and valuation classes on how hypergrowth tech firms burn massive amounts of cash to scale infrastructure.

stories.headline: Apple Reports Record Q4 Revenue as iPhone Duo Faces Severe Delays
stories.body: Apple posted $114.5 billion in revenue for the fourth quarter, a 12% jump year over year. However, executives confirmed that demand for its new iPhone Duo foldable phone has triggered massive shortages with no clear end date in sight.
stories.why: It shows how supply chain bottlenecks can throttle even the most profitable product launches, which is a key operational hurdle for any tech hardware company.

stories.headline: Disney Prepares for Fourth Round of Layoffs With Division Cuts Up to 20%
stories.body: Disney is gearing up for a fresh round of job cuts across divisions like TV networks and its motion picture studio. Managers have been instructed to trim annualized expenses by as much as 20%.
stories.why: Traditional media companies are still aggressively restructuring their cost bases to adjust to shifting consumer habits and streaming pressures.

stories.headline: Trajectory Raises $45 Million to Make AI Training Accessible
stories.body: Startup Trajectory has raised a $45 million round at a $300 million valuation to help nontechnical business experts train specialized AI models without needing deep coding knowledge.
stories.why: As businesses demand practical AI applications over generic tools, companies lowering the technical barrier to customization will capture massive enterprise budgets.

stories.headline: UK Cyber Chief Warns of AI-Powered Attacks on Critical Infrastructure
stories.body: Britain's National Cyber Security Centre warned that the country should prepare for AI-driven cyberattacks on its critical national infrastructure within the next two years, pointing to state-backed actors.
stories.why: Cybersecurity insurance and defense tech will see rising enterprise demand as threats become automated and harder to detect.

stories.headline: Boston Consulting Group Probed by UK Tax Authorities Over Partner Pay
stories.body: Boston Consulting Group is facing an inquiry from Britain's tax authority regarding how it structures partnership pay and calculates taxes for its senior staff.
stories.why: Regulatory scrutiny on professional services partnerships can impact how top-tier consulting firms structure their compensation models.

stories.headline: Alexander Zverev Rises to World No. 1 After Two-Slam Season
stories.body: German tennis star Alexander Zverev officially claimed the ATP Tour singles ranking top spot on Monday, capping off a dominant season where he captured both the French Open and US Open titles.

term.name: Initial Public Offering (IPO)
term.definition: An IPO is the process by which a private company offers its shares to the public for the first time on a stock exchange. Companies use IPOs to raise capital from public investors, which often provides liquidity to early venture capital backers. Anthropic's upcoming market debut is a major test of investor appetite for large-scale tech offerings.

serve.headline: Trajectory raised $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
serve.body: The one-year-old startup secured funding at a $300 million valuation to help businesses customize AI models to learn from their mistakes. The round highlights investor interest in enterprise tools that simplify AI deployment.
